rss_basis: sum of owned process RSS; shared pages may be counted more than once
rss_average_basis: time-weighted mean of adjacent sampled summed process RSS over the active window
rss_peak_basis: maximum summed process RSS sampled during each active window; chart shows the median of the three peaks
cpu_basis: direct cumulative container cgroup CPU; includes owned children, excludes producer
cpu_average_basis: active window cumulative CPU delta divided by elapsed wall time
cpu_peak_basis: maximum adjacent sample CPU delta divided by that sample's elapsed wall time
input: raw native Qoder transcript and intercept tokens; packaged native wakeup or original legacy Stop Hook collection
